target_customer: US health system pharmacy teams responsible for getting patients onto and through therapy
problem: Pharmacy teams spend hours on chart review, insurance portals and payer rules to get prior authorizations approved and patients to complete treatment.
business_model: B2B enterprise SaaS sold to health systems
product_category: Healthcare AI, medication access and prior authorization

founders.name: Rishabh Jain
founders.background_notes: YC page calls him a repeat founder; an eight-figure prior exit claim in one profile is uncorroborated and not recorded.

founders.name: Sri Somasundaram
founders.background_notes: Per YC page, researched molecular binding at Stanford and built deep reinforcement learning robots.

technical_complexity.rationale: Requires reading unstructured charts, payer rules and drug labels reliably, with clinical accuracy and EHR integration.

defensibility.rationale: Health system integrations and accumulated payer rule knowledge raise switching costs, while competitors build similar prior authorization AI.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Prior authorization AI vendors grew in parallel; later coverage names them as peers, but no incumbent absorbed the wedge.

market_need_then: Prior authorization and medication access delays are a known burden for health systems; the YC description cites weeks of waiting for insurance approval and thin pharmacy staffing.

identity.voice_and_tone: Mission-driven healthcare voice: getting breakthrough medicine to every patient.

brand_strength.rationale: A generic word that required a health suffix in the domain; no press on the brand itself, though funding coverage was wide.

outcome_analysis: Latent grew from a two-founder YC company to about 140 people, serving more than 70 health systems per the YC page, and announced an 80M USD Series A in March 2026 co-led by Spark Capital and Transformation Capital. Strong enterprise traction in a painful workflow explains the raise; earlier rounds are not documented in sources found.
notes: The Series A is confirmed by Business Wire, McKesson Ventures and Parsers.vc as found in search results; the Business Wire page returned 403 when fetched and the company website fetch was rate limited, so details come from search snippets. Dealroom says total raised over 93M USD, which implies earlier rounds not itemized; one directory lists a 40M seed plus Series A combination and a roughly 600M valuation, both unverified. Axios Pro (September 2025) reported talks to raise 50M or more. No competitor source dated near the batch was found; Cohere Health and Anterior are cited in 2026 coverage. Name origin not found.
